title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Twilio
providers.scope_notes: Twilio cloud APIs; PKCV needs Enterprise or Security Edition, OAuth apps are US1-only, and Monitor Events keeps 30 days (13 months with Administration, Security or Enterprise Edition).

no_control.what: PKCV cannot be enforced on accounts that use Flex, Studio or TaskRouter, so the Auth Token stays valid there.

controls_unknown: IP allowlisting for REST API credentials (Auth Token, API keys, OAuth).
Expiry settings for API keys and Auth Tokens.
Whether org SSO enforcement or SCIM deactivation affects any API credential.
Org-wide policy to block Main key or Auth Token use other than PKCV.
Whether Monitor Events records read (GET) API calls or token issuance.
Whether actor_sid identifies the API key SID (SK) or only the account.

auth_paths.name: Public Key Client Validation (signed request JWT)

authentication.summary: Each request carries a JWT signed with the customer's RSA private key (kid = public key CredentialSid, iss = API key SID) plus API key credentials. When enforced, Auth Token alone is rejected for REST.

renewal.summary: New JWT per request; rotate key pairs via Credentials PublicKeys.

administration.summary: Enforced from Console Settings; cannot be enforced if Flex, Studio or TaskRouter are used.

offboard.details: Signed requests use an account's API key and public key credential, which belong to the account, not a user.

inventory.details: GET https://accounts.twilio.com/v1/Credentials/PublicKeys lists public key credentials, one account at a time.

expiry.api: Set the exp claim in the signed request JWT; max exp - nbf is 300 s

usage.ui: Monitor > Insights > Audit > Audit Events Log

reads.ui: Monitor > Insights > Audit > Audit Events Log; filter EventType recording.accessed

token_format.notes: JWT with cty twilio-pkrv;v=1, kid=CR... credential SID.

lifecycle_events.notes: Assumed to cover public key credentials; mapping not stated

containment.steps: Delete the public key credential and the API key used as iss.
containment.notes: Deleting the API key used as iss revokes REST API authentication. Docs do not separately describe deleting the public key credential.

calls.log_notes: Monitor Events; 30 days, or 13 months with Administration, Security or Enterprise Edition. actor_sid is the Account SID, not the key.
